open_points.question: When an otherwise-valid configuration exceeds json_depth_max, which ordered load_installation check and reason must be reported?
options: Treat it as the existing configuration parse/object failure, with no distinct depth check or reason
Treat depth as a distinct check between the private-file check and the one-JSON-object check
open_points.default_guess: Treat it as the existing configuration parse failure, because A20 explicitly says depth adds no outcome of its own.
